milestones.title: Open the Discover feed
milestones.detail: See what's trending and worth selling right now.

milestones.title: Open a niche that catches your eye
milestones.detail: Tap any card to see the product, the margin, and where to source it.

milestones.title: Pick your niche
milestones.detail: Choose the one you want to build in. Everything else tunes to it.

milestones.title: Find where to source your product
milestones.detail: Open the sourcing link on your niche's product.

milestones.title: Name your business
milestones.detail: Give it a name — you can change it later.

milestones.title: Start your business
milestones.detail: Lock it in and make it official inside the app.

milestones.title: Open a place to sell
milestones.detail: Set up an Etsy, Shopify, or Instagram shop.

milestones.title: Take your first product photos
milestones.detail: Good light, plain background. This sells the product.

milestones.title: List your first product
milestones.detail: Put it up for sale with your own description.

milestones.title: Open the Grow feed
milestones.detail: See the communities where your customers already gather.

milestones.title: Find a community for your niche
milestones.detail: Open one and read who you'll find there.

milestones.title: Focus on one community
milestones.detail: Pick the one you'll show up in first.

milestones.title: Introduce yourself there
milestones.detail: Show up as a person, not an ad — follow the community's playbook.

milestones.title: Make your first sale
milestones.detail: The one that turns a hobby into a business.

milestones.title: Log your first sale
milestones.detail: Record it in the app to start tracking your growth.

milestones.title: Find a second niche to grow into
milestones.detail: Pick a different niche in Discover — time to expand.
